title: Krishi Chasma SDK & Agentic IoT Automation
description: An automated agricultural intelligence ecosystem marrying embedded edge nodes (ESP32 / Raspberry Pi) with YOLO and DenseNet vision models. Integrates LLM-powered agentic diagnostics, sensor telemetry (soil, temperature, humidity), and automated climate alert dispatchers tailored for low-connectivity rural zones.
architecture: Hardware Edge Nodes -> Sensor Fusion -> Edge Vision Pipeline -> Local / Cloud LLM Agent Reasoning -> SMS / Voice Alert Engine

title: DOAIxILPRL Nepali Tokenizer & Preprocessing Suite
description: Specialized tokenizer and morphological segmentation pipeline engineered for indigenous and low-resource Devanagari languages. Released under the DOAIxILPRL-KU department organization on Hugging Face to standardize subword vocabulary construction for Nepali and Newari language models.
architecture: Unigram / Byte-Pair Encoding trained on high-purity Nepali text with custom Devanagari Unicode normalizers.

title: Automated Government Agricultural Data Harvester
description: Robust Python data scraper designed to systematically navigate and curate unstructured tabular, textual, and PDF crop data from Nepalese government portals (.gov.np). Employs automated document parser filters and rate-limited multithreading to build standardized open datasets.

title: Invasive Plant Species Vision Classifier & Dataset
description: Computer vision pipeline and benchmark dataset developed for identifying invasive plant species threatening agricultural ecosystems in Nepal. Released dataset on Hugging Face and trained convolutional classifiers with transfer learning.

title: SLAM-Based Autonomous Robot Navigation
description: Implemented real-time Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms on embedded microcontroller hardware. Designed motor-drive kinematics, LIDAR/ultrasonic sensor fusion, and dynamic obstacle avoidance routines for indoor autonomous navigation.

title: Autonomous Hotel Waiter Robot
description: Bachelor of Engineering capstone project inspired by Paaila Technology. Built an autonomous service robot capable of table delivery, interactive audio prompts, trajectory tracking, and real-time payload stabilization.
